name: Jeff Daniels
title: Live Events Professional
bio: Jeff is a highly experienced live events professional with deep expertise in technical direction, media servers, and video systems. Known for his calm demeanor and sharp problem-solving instincts, he brings the same reliability to the world's biggest stages that he brings to everything he does — whether that's a 50,000-person show or a mountain pass on two wheels.

projects.title: Large-Scale Live Productions
projects.desc: Technical direction and media server operation for large-scale live events, managing complex video workflows and redundant systems from pre-production through show day.

projects.title: Corporate & Conference Events
projects.desc: Technical leadership for high-profile corporate productions requiring broadcast-quality output, multi-screen video setups, and precise real-time content management.

projects.title: Touring & Festival Productions
projects.desc: Technical director and video systems operator on major touring and festival productions, delivering consistent excellence across venues of all sizes nightly.

projects.title: Broadcast & Live Streaming
projects.desc: Technical lead for broadcast-quality live productions with redundant video infrastructure and real-time switching for global audiences.
